ipxact:register.ipxact:name: VERSION
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Hardware version register (semantic versioning: major.minor.patch)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: patch
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Patch version number

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: minor
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Minor version number

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: major
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Major version number

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved; must read as zero

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control register (reserved for future use)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SOFT_RST_CODE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Software reset code register. Write 0x53525354 ('SRST') to trigger soft reset. Any other value has no effect.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: code
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 32-bit reset code. Write 0x53525354 to trigger soft reset.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQ_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt status register. Sticky bits cleared by writing 1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_parity_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ROM parity error detected. Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sram_parity_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SRAM parity error detected. Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_write_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ROM write attempt detected (ROM is read-only). Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sram_write_lock_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SRAM write attempt to a write-locked region detected. Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: axi_slverr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: AXI SLVERR (slave error) response detected on CPU bus transaction. Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: axi_decerr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: AXI DECERR (decode error) response detected on CPU bus transaction. Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: drbg_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: DRBG Sampler error (timeout or AXI-Stream error). Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wipe_state
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Wipe state event (rising edge of wipe_state input). Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: otp_change
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: An OTP readout field value changed (decoded value differs from prior cycle). Sticky, write 1 to clear. Check OTP_CHANGE_STATUS for the specific field(s).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: otp_sigint
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: OTP dual-rail encoding integrity violation: value and complement are not complementary on at least one field. Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: exec_violation
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Instruction fetch from a non-whitelisted (non-executable) memory region detected, excluding the KM ROM. Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_access_violation
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: KM ROM instruction fetch or data read attempted after the ROM lockout engaged. The lockout engages on the first committed instruction fetch from write-locked SRAM once SRAM_EXEC_MODE.enable is set, and clears only on warm or cold reset. Sticky, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQ_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt enable/mask register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_parity_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable ROM parity error interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sram_parity_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable SRAM parity error interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_write_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable ROM write error interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sram_write_lock_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable SRAM write-lock violation interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: axi_slverr_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable AXI SLVERR error interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: axi_decerr_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable AXI DECERR error interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: drbg_err_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable DRBG Sampler error interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wipe_state_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable wipe state interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: otp_change_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable OTP field change interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: otp_sigint_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable OTP dual-rail integrity violation interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: exec_violation_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable execute-permission whitelist violation interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_access_violation_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable ROM lockout violation interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SCRAMBLER_KEY
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 32-bit scrambler key for SRAM address/data scrambling. When locked: writes ignored, reads return 0. No reset; powers up random.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: key
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Scrambler key value. Not readable when SCRAMBLER_CTRL.LOCK=1 (returns 0). No reset for security; power-up value undefined.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SCRAMBLER_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Scrambler control register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable SRAM scrambling. When 0, data passes through unmodified. Locked when LOCK=1 (security requirement).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lock
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lock scrambler key and enable bit. Once set, key and enable cannot be modified until reset. Write-once (0->1 only). Security requirement: prevents disabling scrambling after key provisioning.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SRAM_LOCK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SRAM write-lock bits. Bit[i]=1 locks region i (1 KB each, 32 regions). Write-1-only: writing 1 sets the bit, writing 0 has no effect. Cleared by warm or cold reset (warm reset domain); ROM re-applies the lock policy on every boot before handover to mutable firmware.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lock_bits
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit per 1 KB SRAM region. Region 0 = 0x8000-0x83FF, region 31 = 0xFC00-0xFFFF. Write 1 to lock; 0 has no effect. Warm reset domain: cleared by warm or cold reset.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQ_SET
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt set register. Write 1 to trigger corresponding interrupt (for ISR testing). Write-only, reads return 0.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_parity_err_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.ROM_PARITY_ERR (triggers ROM parity interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sram_parity_err_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.SRAM_PARITY_ERR (triggers SRAM parity interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_write_err_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.ROM_WRITE_ERR (triggers ROM write interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sram_write_lock_err_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.SRAM_WRITE_LOCK_ERR (triggers SRAM write-lock interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: axi_slverr_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.AXI_SLVERR (triggers AXI SLVERR interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: axi_decerr_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.AXI_DECERR (triggers AXI DECERR interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: drbg_err_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.DRBG_ERR (triggers DRBG Sampler interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wipe_state_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.WIPE_STATE (triggers wipe state interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: otp_change_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.OTP_CHANGE (triggers OTP change interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: otp_sigint_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.OTP_SIGINT (triggers OTP sigint interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: exec_violation_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.EXEC_VIOLATION (triggers exec-permission violation interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_access_violation_set
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set IRQ_STATUS.ROM_ACCESS_VIOLATION (triggers ROM lockout violation interrupt for testing)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved (write-only; reads trigger SLVERR via err_if_bad_rw)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SRAM_WRITE_LOCK_VIOLATION
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Which SRAM region(s) had write attempts while locked. Bit[i]=region i. Sticky, write 1 to clear each bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: violation_bits
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bit[i]=1 if region i had attempted write while locked. Sticky, write 1 to clear each bit.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RECOVERABLE_ERR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Recoverable error status. Firmware writes 1 to set (after recovering in ISR), writes 0 to clear (e.g. when SEP requests clear). Drives recoverable error event output.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: recoverable_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 1 = recoverable fault occurred and was handled by ISR; 0 = clear. Write 1 to set, write 0 to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: BOOT_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Boot status. Firmware writes 1 to COLD_BOOT_DONE after cold-boot init completes; bit remains set until next cold reset.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cold_boot_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write-1-only: set by ROM firmware at end of cold boot. Reads 0 after cold reset; reads 1 after firmware sets it. Sticky until next cold reset (preserved across warm resets).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: OTP_LIFE_CYCLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Life cycle state. 8-bit (4-bit value differentially encoded). Read-through from OTP port; no reset.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 8-bit life cycle state from OTP. No reset; power-up value undefined.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: OTP_DEMOTION_STATE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Demotion state. 2-bit, differentially encoded. Read-through from OTP port; no reset.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: demote_1_value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 2-bit demotion 1 state from OTP. No reset; power-up value undefined.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: demote_2_value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 2-bit demotion 2 state from OTP. No reset; power-up value undefined.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SRAM_EXEC_MODE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Execute-permission whitelist mode. Write-1-only (woset); cleared by warm or cold reset. 0=ROM executable; 1=write-locked SRAM regions executable, and the ROM lockout is armed. Set by ROM stack-less handover immediately before jumping to mutable firmware.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Execute-permission mode: 0=ROM-only whitelist; 1=write-locked SRAM whitelist, arming the ROM lockout. Write 1 to set; write 0 has no effect. Warm reset domain: cleared by warm or cold reset.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQ_ENTRY_ADDR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Effective IRQ entry address for subsequent interrupts. Writable while unlocked; any 32-bit value accepted.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: IRQ handler entry PC. Reset matches ROM vector at 0x10. When locked, SW writes do not update storage.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQ_ENTRY_LOCK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Write-one-only lock for IRQ_ENTRY_ADDR. Separate readable register; cleared only on KM reset.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lock
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write 1 to set; write 0 has no effect; sticky until reset.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved; reads as zero.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: VUART_TX
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Virtual UART transmit register. Write a byte to send to testbench. DATA_VALID is set on write and self-clears.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: tx_byte
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Byte to transmit (write to send character to testbench)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data valid strobe. Set by firmware on write, cleared by hardware after one cycle.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: VUART_RX
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Virtual UART receive register. Testbench writes bytes here for firmware to read.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rx_byte
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Received byte from testbench

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: RX data valid. Set by testbench, cleared by firmware read.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: VUART_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Virtual UART status register for flow control

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: tx_ready
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TX ready to accept data (always 1 in simulation)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rx_valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: RX has valid data available

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: print_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable VUART printing. Set by testbench to enable printf output. Disabled by default to save simulation time.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TB_RESULT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Test result register. Firmware writes 0=fail, 1=pass.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: result
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test result: 0=fail, 1=pass

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TB_SIGNATURE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Test completion signature. Firmware writes 0x600D600D (pass) or 0xBADBADBA (fail).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: signature
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Completion signature value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TB_ERRCODE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Test error code register. Firmware writes optional error code for debugging.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: errcode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Error code value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TB_SUBTEST
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Current subtest number register. Firmware increments for each subtest.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: subtest
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Current subtest number

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TB_CMD
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Testbench command register. Firmware writes command, testbench reads and clears.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cmd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Command code (0=NOP, 1=ROM_PARITY_EN, 2=ROM_PARITY_DIS, 3=SRAM_PARITY_EN, 4=SRAM_PARITY_DIS)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TB_CMD_ARG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Testbench command argument register. Firmware writes optional argument.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: arg
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Command argument value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TB_CMD_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Testbench command status register. Testbench writes status, firmware reads.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: status
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Command status: 0=IDLE, 1=ACK, 0xFFFFFFFF=ERR

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TB_CMD_RESULT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Testbench command result register. Testbench writes result value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: result
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Command result value

ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Debug register with known constant value for verification

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: magic
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Magic constant: 0xCAFEBEEF
